## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem, task ID, and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Swift/backend build, tests, lint, and formatting pass
- [ ] Catalogs and bundle verified if app resources changed
- [ ] Docs and roadmap reflect actual completion
- [ ] No secrets, raw transcript/audio logs, or unrelated changes
- [ ] Prompt eval results included when prompts change

## Remaining limitations

State unverified behavior, external dependencies, and rollout considerations.
